atoms.text:
Every year in Spring, the “Pancake Race” takes place in England. It is a race between teams and works like a relay race.
Each team has a frying pan and a pancake in it. The first member runs to the second member while flipping the pancake along the way. The second member then takes the pan with the pancake and runs to the third member while flipping the pancake. It continues like this until each player flipped the pancake.
The fastest team wins the race.

atoms.text:
Every second sunday of September, the town of Ramsbottom, which is close to Manchester, hosts an event called “Black Pudding Throwing”. A local legend says that it's been running as early as the 15th century.
There's a 6m high tower with 12 yorkshire puddings on top of it. Each participant gets three black puddings. They throw the black puddings at the yorkshire puddings. The person who knocks the most yorkshire puddings off the tower wins the event.
